claim_scope: bounded user-owned software QA and newly authored synthetic mutation families
selection_rules: Use all five predefined mutation families and both unchanged user-project controls; do not drop losses.
One fault family counts once regardless of seeds, inputs, source/target variants, or replay calls.
Only public development cases may be used to fix implementation or assess run feasibility.
Final cases are newly authored separately and executed once after code, contract, suite and source molds are frozen.
Do not replace final cases, thresholds, seeds, tool settings or verdict criteria after outcomes are observed.

frozen_final_transfer.ledger: exclusive-create append-only run ledger; an attempted final run consumes the suite
frozen_final_transfer.blinding: withheld from generator, not a broad real-world blind benchmark

source_aware_symbolic.oracle_call_cap: internal symbolic calls are not exposed by CLI; UNKNOWN

method_rules.E4: Unmodified v0.4.0a1 APIs, only supported two-integer domains; other domains NOT_COMPARABLE.
method_rules.Hypothesis: Native typed strategies and find/shrink on development; native Strategy generation without Oracle for frozen final planning. Use explicit seed, no database, cache repeated pure-input callbacks when adapter supports it.
method_rules.CrossHair: Actual installed CLI on the same trusted target/model contract, source-aware tier, no weakening of preconditions to favor E5.
method_rules.E5: Integrated service on the same public typed spec and approved reference IR; frozen transfer uses development source molds and target public reference IR only.

oracle_equivalence: Canonical JSON outcome equality as used by the integrated service; dictionary key order is ignored, tuple/list serialize identically, and numeric encodings are compared explicitly. Reference functions return canonical positive zero for absolute-value floating results. Output nominal-type equivalence beyond this JSON contract is not established.

metrics.unique_faults: Distinct predefined fault-family IDs with independently confirmed concrete mismatches; seeds and repeated inputs never count as separate faults.
metrics.first_failure_oracle_calls: Actual reference invocations through the independent meter before first mismatch; includes repeated calls when actually executed.
metrics.first_failure_wall_seconds: Time from worker process launch to first independently observed mismatch, including candidate generation and imports.
metrics.wall_seconds: Observed parent wall time, including complete search/shrink/replay and generator startup.
metrics.cpu_seconds: Worker process_time is a separate metric. Process-tree CPU is a sampled lower bound formed by summing the last observed CPU times for each PID/create-time identity, including launcher and descendants. Worker CPU is not added again. Short-lived unseen processes may be missed; not billing-grade accounting.
metrics.peak_rss_bytes: Sampled peak sum of worker and descendant RSS at 10 ms intervals; sampled and platform-dependent.
metrics.failure_diversity: Predeclared semantic fault families, not scalar model scores.
metrics.duplicate_failure_rate: Duplicate confirmed input/signature pairs divided by confirmed failing evaluations.
metrics.wrong_constraints: Supported source constraints contradicted by separately evaluated validation inputs, reported as unconfirmed membership hypotheses rather than proved causal rules.
metrics.structural_transfer_accuracy: Acceptance/rejection of declared type-role-operation-contract-graph correspondences, including explicit validation rejection of malformed declarations. Separately check exact removal of constraints contradicted by an actually evaluated clean development input; that input does not imply rejection of every source hypothesis. Bug recurrence remains UNKNOWN.
metrics.false_alerts: Confirmed mismatch reports on unchanged project clean controls.
metrics.state_cost: Trace invariant evaluations count as Oracle calls; individual transition count is reported separately.

constraint_validation.candidate_selection: sorted canonical constraint IDs; report bounded subset coverage

verdict_rules.GENERALIZATION_IMPROVED: Unavailable for this bounded synthetic/user-owned-control suite; requires a separately authorized independent real-project benchmark.
verdict_rules.EFFICIENCY_IMPROVED_ONLY: E5 detects no fewer unique families and has zero control false alerts, with paired median total wall <=0.80 and paired median first-failure Oracle calls <=0.80 versus every applicable black-box baseline in their shared domain. At least three families must be jointly comparable with the full-type Hypothesis baseline; the narrow E4 stratum is reported separately. Report bounded descriptive evidence only.
verdict_rules.NO_IMPROVEMENT: Required supported runs completed but the efficiency criterion is not met. Saturated detection alone is not an improvement.
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Required comparable runs time out, tool/Oracle infrastructure fails, source freeze drifts, or fewer than three families are jointly comparable.
verdict_rules.NOT_EXECUTED: A requested evaluation scope is not actually executed.

private_not_staged: raw final inputs and Oracle outputs
final source molds and planning ledger
publication.repeat_ci_runs: Public development reproduction is software QA. Previously consumed final results are not presented as new blind evaluations.
